title: Cost, file size and upload limits

videos.script: Every call in this course had a price, even the ones this lab answered for free. {{title}} This lesson reads those prices. Per token, per image, per second, per character. Four units, and none of them is the size of the file. {{units}} Then the file. A picture can be made smaller before it is sent. Sometimes that saves money and sometimes it only loses the answer. {{shrink}} Then the limits. Twenty-five megabytes of audio, and a picture that grows by a third on its way into a request. {{limits}} And two habits that keep a bill predictable. Never pay twice for the same question, and check what a user may spend before the call, not after. {{end}}
